target.statement: Silhouette score of 0.664 for Agglomerative (average linkage) clustering with k=15 on 4D UMAP (neighbors=10, min_dist=0.01) using TF-IDF weighted codebook counts.

compute.basis: The dataset is tiny (81 works, 770 keywords); embedding with two large models on CPU is feasible, and the clustering sweep (800+ configs) on such small data should complete in minutes on 8 CPU cores.

blockers: Code repository may not include exact preprocessing scripts or the released features; paper says 'released features and scripts' but completeness unknown.
Requires downloading BGE-large-en-v1.5 and GTE-large-en-v1.5 models (~1.3GB each) and running them on CPU, which is slow but manageable.
UMAP and clustering hyperparameters are specified, but exact random seeds and library versions may affect reproducibility.
title: BioArtlas: Computational Clustering of Multi-Dimensional Complexity in Bioart
